bio: Satvik is a five-year-old model based in Chennai, working across editorial, catalogue and campaign photography. He is comfortable under studio lighting and on location, takes direction well for his age, and holds an expression without prompting. His range spans formal tailoring, activewear and traditional festive dress.
note: Available for editorial, catalogue, campaign and lookbook work. Always accompanied by a parent or guardian on set.
availability: Available for bookings — Chennai and wider Tamil Nadu
